supersedes.note: Historical campaigns keep 0.1.0-draft, its fixtures (including the 0.1 tool-recovery substring oracle) and existing campaign wrappers unchanged. Changes in 0.2: tool-recovery fixture v0.2 (published tool schemas plus the known initial path in the task, service name learned from config, per-call recorded results validated against the deterministic executor, exact structured final answer); new linux-diagnosis fixture with two evidence-grounded cases; new multidocument useful-context family extending the document-synthesis domain; explicit applicability vocabulary and review metadata. Required-core coverage and the qualitative-review doctrine are unchanged.

purpose: Constrain role claims to observed real tasks, not a single synthetic probe. Preregister applicability and frozen fixtures/oracles before results; score what the model actually produced, never what a fixture synthesized on its behalf.

applicability_vocabulary.NOT_TESTED: Required whenever the fixture is absent from the campaign or a claimed role was never run. A claimed role without its fixture or run is NOT_TESTED in that role — never PASS and never FAIL. This includes an unrun claimed role on an otherwise applicable profile.
applicability_vocabulary.NOT_APPLICABLE: Permitted only with recorded evidence that the role is excluded for the tested profile (for example, a preflight record demonstrating no qualified native tool-call interface). The excluding evidence path must appear in the manifest or report; an unevidenced NOT_APPLICABLE is invalid.
applicability_vocabulary.FAIL: Reserved for a run of a frozen fixture whose oracle failed. Inapplicability is never FAIL.

required_core.method: Frozen bounded task set plus explicit blinded qualitative review for prose and ambiguity; deterministic assertions for provided facts, omissions and strict constraints. Do not infer general quality from the existing 12-task quality screen alone.

coverage: strict JSON consumed by a parser
required_core.method: Parse exact object and test semantic fields, duplicate keys and extraneous output; do not reward parseable-but-wrong values.

conditional_modules.applicable_when: Coding or repository assistant role is claimed
conditional_modules.minimum: Frozen small real repository with files, defect/change, executable sandboxed tests, diff inspection and unrelated-change detection; include diagnosis and implementation, not only isolated function trivia
conditional_modules.claim_if_missing: NOT_TESTED; do not call the model a coding assistant on the isolated moving_sum probe alone

conditional_modules.minimum: Two distinct realistic sanitized log/config cases; structured observations with source IDs; supported-cause selection, safe non-destructive proposed repair, unknown present health and explicit no execution; the mechanical layer fails committed claims that contradict the evidence registry, and detail prose additionally requires blinded independent review

conditional_modules.applicable_when: A qualified native tool interface exists and agent/tool role is claimed
conditional_modules.minimum: Correct choice/arguments with per-call recorded results validated against the deterministic executor; sequence, recoverable error and retry, call budget, grounded exact structured final answer and stopping; tool observations come from the executor replay, never from model-authored claims; the task publishes the available schemas and the known initial path while the service name is learned from config
Retain actual model prior turn, incorporate user correction, preserve earlier constraints, distinguish absent status, strict JSON

Family A controlled retrieval plus the separately frozen realistic multidocument family (fixtures/useful_context/multidocument.json; harness/capabilities.py:construct_multidocument and score_multidocument) and, where relevant, repository/session context families with distinct oracles and maxima; repository and session dimensions stay NOT_TESTED without their own fixtures
conditional_modules.claim_if_missing: Only Family A maximum; other dimensions NOT_TESTED

review_metadata.reviewer_class: Every scoring layer of every task class records reviewer_class: HUMAN | AGENT | DETERMINISTIC in the campaign evidence.
review_metadata.subjectivity_rule: A dimension is subjective exactly when a frozen deterministic rule cannot decide correctness (prose quality, diagnostic detail, ambiguity handling, summarization usefulness). Deciding subjectivity routes the dimension to blinded independent review; the deterministic layer remains necessary-but-not-sufficient there and may never adjudicate it.
review_metadata.independence_and_blinding: Subjective layers require independent review with model identity blinded, retaining disagreements and uncertainty. DETERMINISTIC layers may be executed by code or an agent without review; an AGENT reviewer must not decide a subjective dimension that the frozen rubric requires humans (or blinded independent panels) to adjudicate.

qualitative_review: Freeze rubric for correctness, completeness, relevance, clarity, verbosity, fabrication, constraints, prose/diagnostic usefulness; blind model identity where feasible, retain independent evaluator notes and disagreements, no false decimal precision or 'intelligence retained' score.
agent_safety: Use local deterministic simulated read-only tools and sandboxed code oracles; no destructive external tools; no model inference as part of fixture selftests; selftests never execute generated model code — only the trusted repository reference transcripts and their mutations are scored.

limitations.one_task_per_fixture: Each real-work fixture is one task instance: the repository fixture's four test checks, the tool fixture's per-event checks, each linux-diagnosis case's per-key checks and the multidocument family's per-field checks are aspects of their single tasks, not independent tasks. Do not report per-check counts as task counts.
limitations.one_multidocument_family: Exactly one multidocument family exists and it extends the document-synthesis domain. A short construction run establishes construction and placement mechanics only; useful-context claims at depth require the family at real rung occupancy under the context-scaling method. Family A remains the only controlled longitudinal family.
limitations.linux_cases: The linux fixture carries two cases; scoring one case is one task instance of evidence.

report: Report each role's evidence, applicability (with the vocabulary above), failures, prompt/budget/profile identities, latency/resource envelope and untested dimensions. Phase advance and final verdict are separate.
